interactions.note: The epitope-specific (A1)Nb10 bound to a complex of A1(OBdelta) and A6, as shown by gel filtration of the ternary complex. The construct A1(OBdelta) consisted of residues 626-657 and 696-762 of RNA-editing complex protein MP81 with the 38-residue (658-695) loop L23 replaced by GASG.

The epitope of (A1)Nb10 on the construct A1(OBdelta) was determined from the crystal structure of the complex, solved by molecular replacement. The construct A1(OBdelta) consisted of residues 626-657 and 696-762 of RNA-editing complex protein MP81 with the 38-residue (658-695) loop L23 replaced by GASG. Form I belongs to space group P2<sub>1</sub>2<sub>1</sub>2. A ternary complex of A1(OBdelta)/A6/ (A1)Nb10 was crystallized, but the asymmetric unit contained two copies of A1(OBdelta) and two copies of (A1)Nb10, indicating A6 dissociated. Binding of (A1)Nb10 did not prevent the ability of a complex of A1 and RNA ligase L2 to bind dsRNA.; Unmapped quantitative response: 3D structure 1.97 angstroms
